_validation_note: 14-day window (June 9-23, 2026) produced zero survivors. Broadened to 21-day window (June 2-23, 2026) per protocol. 21-day window added two additional candidates but both failed non-window gates. Dominant failure mode: Gate 4 — most candidates lacked a fetched source explicitly linking the mechanism to AI, ML, or data center workloads in an Alaska-specific sentence. The DOE EDF/Oklo/Eielson candidate appeared promising but collapsed when the Power Magazine Oklo/Eielson article was confirmed dated June 11, 2025 (not 2026) via WebFetch, and the June 23, 2026 DOE EDF announcement covers AP1000 reactors exclusively. The JBER/JITTC-E candidate fell at Gate 4 (TWZ article has no AI language) and Gate 5 (JITTC-E contract already awarded July 2025). This is the tenth consecutive no-target cycle since June 13, 2026. The bar was not lowered. An honest no-target is the correct outcome for this cycle.
